ticket.subject: Timezone wrong after the clock change
ticket.body_text:
Hello support,

Writing on behalf of Hollowfen Media. Our 8:00 reports now come at 9:00, which started right after the clocks changed.

We can send the reports by hand in the meantime.

A reply in the next few days would be great. Could you check the scheduler?

Best,
Freya
